title: Linked List Cycle Detection
description: Given an array `nodes` representing node values and `pos` representing the index that the tail connects to (-1 if no cycle), determine if the linked list has a cycle in it.

hints.content: If pos is -1, there is no cycle. If pos >= 0 and within bounds, a cycle exists.
Fast pointer moves 2 steps, slow pointer moves 1 step. If they meet, a cycle exists.

solution.explanation:
Under pointer nodes, Floyds cycle detection uses fast and slow pointers. With pos representation, pos >= 0 indicates a loop.
Time Complexity: O(1)
Space Complexity: O(1)
